bug_fixed.issue: Stats bar counters for 'On-Time Payments' (98%) and 'Late Fees Saved' ($150,000+) were showing 0% and $0+ instead of animating to target values
bug_fixed.root_cause: The useCountUp hook returns a ref that must be attached to a DOM element for IntersectionObserver to trigger. Only stat1.ref was attached to the section, while stat2.ref and stat3.ref were not attached to any element.
bug_fixed.fix: Added ref={stat2.ref} and ref={stat3.ref} to the respective stat divs in the Stats Bar section
